plainText:
Sird (Japanese: サキ Saque) is one of The Three Beasts of Team Rocket in the of the Pokémon Adventures manga. In the , she was revealed to be one of the Team Galactic Commanders.

 

==History==
=== ===
Sird was first seen as a silhouette in the Hoenn region with , Carr, and Orm. They recovered remains of the Blue and Red Orbs, which have been turned into a and , after the battle between and .

=== ===
 
In her first appearance, Sird worked with and the other Beasts on the Sevii Islands and fought and defeated Lorelei on Seven Island. Later, she fell from the Team Rocket airship after it was taken over by Carr, but she survived. She later tried to catch by disabling it with an energy beam launched from her Poké Ball (later on revealed to be being unleashed), but was foiled when , , , , and (along with ) used their bodies to block the beam from Deoxys, who escaped. However, to their surprise, the five Pokédex holders' bodies were turned to stone as a result. Having one of Lorelei's ice cuffs pinned and rapidly expanding from her left leg before she attempted the capture, she fled after remarking that this new gain is nothing short of capturing Deoxys as she had intended.
 

=== ===
Later, after the climax of the battle against the evil Guile Hideout, Archie reveals that Sird temporarily saved his and Maxie's lives just as they were about to be killed while fleeing in an air-car, at the end of the . The means that she did this are unknown. She offered him and Maxie the armor and sword that would later transform Archie into Guile Hideout, claimed they would give eternal life, but said that there was only one armor so they would have to fight to the death to see who would gain the armor, with Archie winning and killing Maxie in the end. Strangely enough, after she gave the armor to Archie, she quoted , which similarly refers to a man with a sword. Also worth noting is in a flashback from Crystal, before Archie and the armor vanished, when she asked who was behind it Archie muttered out " ", the first few syllables of Team Galactic, foreshadowing Sird's connection to the team.

=== ===
Sird appeared in Carr's flashback in Dealing With A Koffing Fit, where Carr refused to allow not even his colleagues or Giovanni to take his position.

=== ===
In Beedrill Prepares, Sird was seen in a flashback with Giovanni, Carr, and Orm, where they were being watched by Blaise while recovering the remains of the orbs.

=== ===
Sird reappeared to take part in the Spear Pillar, following the defeat of Jupiter, Mars and Saturn, sporting a new Galactic-styled uniform. She still has problems with the injuries she suffered because of Lorelei.

Sird reveals that she only helped Archie or worked with Team Rocket as an undercover mission for her boss Cyrus, in order to investigate about Pokémon from outer space, namely or . To fulfill her agendas, she selected a and released him from the Team Galactic hive mind, implanting her will on him instead to carry out plans autonomously. This Grunt became known as the Advanced level Grunt, and inherited Sird's obsession with the Pokédex, which she developed after her first encounter with the Pokédex holders. Following the petrification incident, she explains that Mewtwo chased her all the way back to Sinnoh out of revenge for the Trainers she petrified, and she barely managed to escape its pursuit.

Following this explanation, Riley appears and engages her in battle. She easily avoided all of his attacks and was able to escape along with the other Commanders.

=== ===
Sird is revealed to have released Darkrai into the Distortion World, having deemed herself as unable to control it.

It is not known what happened to her following Team Galactic's defeat and disbandment.

==Trivia==
Sird has direct or indirect relation with all four main villainous teams from Generations to . She was part of both Team Rocket and Team Galactic, and she gave armor and a sword to both Archie and Maxie, the leaders of Team Aqua and Team Magma respectively.
Sird and her teammates are based on various fictional monsters. In Sird's case, she is based on .
